name: antonio-andara-field-manual
description: Antonio Andara — engineering, open source, experiments, and magic.

scripts.build: elm make src/Main.elm --optimize --output=assets/elm.js && elm make src/LibraryPage.elm --optimize --output=assets/library.js && npm run build:three-color && npm run build:lms
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:404 && npm run test:three-color && npm run test:lms && npm run test:lab
scripts.build:three-color: node experiments/build/generate-default.mjs && cd experiments && elm make src/FormulaMosaic.elm --optimize --output=three-color-mosaic.js
scripts.build:lms: cd projects/lms/demo && node scripts/generate-book.mjs && elm make src/Main.elm --optimize --output=elm.js
